summary: T3 Defense Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary's SPAC, SC II Acquisition Corp., terminated a non-binding LOI with a payments technology target, ending a potential business combination. The SPAC, controlled by T3's wholly-owned subsidiary Nukkleus Defense Technologies Inc., informed the target on July 12, 2026, of the termination effective immediately. No deal terms were disclosed; the LOI had been entered on March 31, 2026. No premium, break fee, or advisor named. The termination leaves the SPAC with only confidentiality obligations, and T3 faces uncertainty regarding future deployment of the SPAC. Watch for any new target announcement or liquidation risk.
